We help families and professionals across Nairobi find quality homes to rent and buy. Our team handles viewings, leases and property management so that landlords and tenants both have a smooth experience from the first call to move-in day.

Call us WhatsApp us

Our services

Residential lettings: we market vacant units, screen tenants, prepare tenancy agreements and conduct check-in inspections with a full photo inventory. Sales: we value homes, list them with professional photos and handle negotiations through to completion with your lawyer.

Property management: rent collection, monthly statements, service charge administration, routine maintenance and caretaker supervision. Many of our landlords live abroad and rely on us for regular updates and transparent accounting every month.

Short stays: fully furnished apartments in Kilimani, Westlands and Kileleshwa for business travellers and families relocating to Nairobi, with flexible weekly or monthly terms and housekeeping included.

Why clients choose us

We are a registered estate agency with a physical office, a dedicated team for viewings and a clear fee structure that we explain before you sign anything. We answer enquiries quickly and we keep landlords informed about every tenant application, every repair and every payment. Our goal is simple: happy tenants, well looked after buildings and landlords who never have to chase rent.

Over the years we have built strong relationships with developers, caretakers and service providers across the city, which means we can usually find a unit that matches your budget and location within a few days. We also help corporate clients with staff housing and relocation support.
